title: screw it
description: A vanilla-friendly Fabric modpack that improves performance and usability while remaining fully multiplayer-safe. Includes optimization and practical tools without changing core gameplay.
body:
A lightweight, vanilla-friendly Fabric modpack focused on performance, stability, and practical quality-of-life improvements. It is designed primarily for singleplayer, where it can provide noticeable performance and usability benefits, but it is also fully safe to use on multiplayer servers, as it only includes client-side and non-intrusive mods.

The modpack combines modern optimization mods that improve FPS, reduce stuttering, optimize memory usage, and speed up chunk loading, all while preserving vanilla behavior and game mechanics. No gameplay systems, balance, or progression are altered, ensuring compatibility with both vanilla and modded servers.

In addition to optimization, the pack includes a curated set of builder and utility tools such as Axiom, Litematica, and Flashback, making it suitable for creative building, technical planning, and replay or analysis workflows. Visual and usability enhancements like Gamma Utils, Zoomify, and optional Iris shader support further improve the overall experience without being mandatory.

The goal of this modpack is to provide a well-rounded client setup that feels fast, clean, and reliable, whether you are playing survival, building large projects, experimenting in creative, or joining multiplayer servers.
